name: Voltage AI
tagline: Put AI to work inside the systems you already run.

copy.headline: Put AI to work inside what you already run.
copy.lead: Tell us the task you'd love to hand to AI. Get a first read on what's possible, what it needs, and how to do it safely.
points: Built into your existing apps and data.
Measured, guarded and under your control.
copy.goalLabel: What should AI do for you?
copy.goalHint: The task, the system it touches, and what good looks like.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Our support team answers the same 50 questions all day. We'd like an assistant that uses our docs and hands off to a human.
copy.finePrint: No pitch, no pricing. Don't paste passwords, keys or customer data.
